title: Agent eval harness roadmap
body: Track the work needed to build and release the PR review and coding-agent evaluation harness. Each sub-issue has its own completion criteria.

tasks.title: Require the tests check for pull requests into main
tasks.body: Verify the initial implementation PR runs the Python tests and deterministic review and coding replay. Configure a ruleset that requires a PR and the passing tests check on main. Record a successful GitHub Actions run.

tasks.title: Capture an independently verified coding-agent run
tasks.body: Add a pinned task with a known failing fix check and a passing regression check on the baseline. Use a verifier outside the agent-editable patch. Replay a successful fix and a patch with a regression.

tasks.title: Benchmark PR reviews against labeled findings
tasks.body: Add a clean PR and a defect-bearing PR with reviewed findings. Document how free-text findings map to labels and report missed issues, false positives, and duplicates.

tasks.title: Add scope, verifier integrity, budget, and loop metrics
tasks.body: Check protected files and verifier integrity. Capture token, call, time, and retry budgets where available. Distinguish allowed retries, repeated actions without progress, and missing telemetry.

tasks.title: Report repeated judge scores and confidence intervals
tasks.body: Score a fixed trace multiple times with a trace-based rubric. Record individual scores, mean, spread, and failures. Distinguish intervals over judge repeats from intervals across cases and report main and edge groups.

tasks.title: Generate and promote versioned golden cases
tasks.body: Generate synthetic drafts with provenance. Warn below two real goldens per synthetic case and document the 80/20 main-to-edge target. Promote reviewed runs through PRs with an idempotent promotion command.

tasks.title: Generate metric drafts and calibrate against human labels
tasks.body: Draft a deterministic metric and a trace-based rubric. Tune against development cases, evaluate on held-out scenario families, and report false passes and false failures before enabling a metric by default.

tasks.title: Import a Harbor-format benchmark run
tasks.body: Choose native Harbor or Inspect AI for one task. Import a saved run while preserving the task version, verifier outcome, trajectory, and available telemetry. Replay it with the harness metrics.

tasks.title: Publish the first runnable harness release
tasks.body: Verify the credential-free replay commands from a fresh checkout. Include a passing report and a report for a deliberately failed coding case. Tag the first release and link it from the repo README.

title: GitHub portfolio improvements
body: Track public evidence of current work in agent evaluation, coding workflows, Python, and speech ML. Link the published artifact before closing work that happens outside a PR.

tasks.title: Document the Arabic dialect identification thesis and results
tasks.body: Add a root README describing the data2vec classifier, dataset, dialects, personal contribution, evaluation split, and a verified result against a baseline. Link the thesis report if it can be shared.

tasks.title: Make the thesis example reproducible
tasks.body: Document a runnable inference or evaluation command with dependencies and a shareable example. Remove tracked cache artifacts and verify the command from a clean checkout.

tasks.title: Refresh the MATLAB equaliser repository
tasks.body: Consolidate the README, document how to run the test tone, add a before-and-after spectrogram, and remove any personal identifiers from published docs.

tasks.title: Document the Python backend project contributions
tasks.body: Explain what the project does, identify personal contributions and tests, and document how to run it while preserving course and teammate attribution.

tasks.title: Update the GitHub profile and pinned repositories
tasks.body: Add a profile README that leads with current agent evaluation and Python work. Link runnable projects and update the pin order once the harness is ready.

tasks.title: Align the résumé with the portfolio
tasks.body: Link the thesis and the most relevant runnable project. For each linked project, state a personal contribution and a verified result where available.

tasks.title: Publish the coding-agent workflows demo
tasks.body: Document standalone roles and run one end-to-end change with a handoff, review finding, resulting fix, and verification output. Include a command that works from a fresh checkout.
